objective: Implement a separate append-only Gate C-VP approval schema, protected writer, audit contract, and failure-closed tests without creating production authority.

contracts.requirement: Closed approval contract with derived identity/path, Karl-only scope, immutable parent and Gate-C lineage, bounded VM core, single-use declarations, and locked authority flags.
verification: focused malformed and semantic mutation tests

contracts.requirement: Closed canonical audit record binding approval bytes, parent, Gate-C lineage, VM/search-family core, writer outcome, and explicit downstream non-authority facts.
Validate schema, target binding, path confinement, symlink absence, parent bytes/status, exact Gate-C raw line, contract core, and every permanent collision before locking.
verification: path traversal, symlink, and broken-symlink tests
approval, VM, and audit collision tests

contracts.requirement: Repeat mutable-state, corpus, history, and target checks under one repository-local exclusive lock.
Exclusively write the exact reviewed approval bytes, flush/fsync, then append exactly one canonical audit JSON line with one LF.
verification: exact-byte CLI and API success tests
approval hash and audit line assertions

contracts.requirement: Leave no partial artifact on failure, roll back partial commit, surface rollback failure as integrity-critical, and preserve a committed pair when lock cleanup fails.
verification: rollback success and rollback failure tests

contracts.requirement: Fail closed on malformed, missing, tampered, inconsistent, or colliding historical audit/approval evidence.
Reject floats on the protected approval/core surface and hash the exact core with repo_canonical_json_v1 while allowing valid numeric data in referenced Specs and VMs.
Write only one approval, one audit line, and the temporary lock lifecycle; grant no Gate-Q or downstream authority.
Create no real approval, authoritative audit line, VM, Sweep, Gate-Q item, queue item, execution, result, candidate, or runtime state.
